items.text: Oh boy this patch is for the ones that enjoy squishy sounds. Fixed a bunch of stuff and added a couple of gameplay features. Hope you enjoy! :D

Skipping rounds on the map is now dynamic. That means if you drop below the needed threshold while being in the map, you will no longer be able to skip. On the other side, if you gain pips there (by selling cards or rings), you will now be able to skip.
Anchor is now ignored by autoselect
Added a custom sound effect for Magic Sponge
Added a visual indicator of how much value Magic Sponge has gained in a roll

Changed the email in the crash message to bugs@countlessnights.com. please use that one to send bugs and crashes from now on, just to keep everything organized for me :) (I still prefer discord, just in case you use email)

Added Korean

Hey all! I heard you loud and clear, difficulty needs some adjustment. So I made some changes.
This is the first balance patch, I know a lot of you mentioned bosses being harsh in your comments, but I decided to focus on dice and general balance for this first update.

I'm still thinking on how to implement a mechanic that lets you reroll bosses, since I feel like that would be the best way to tackle this problem, but for now, I'll let you guys tell me if you find this new version more forgiving overall! (I did nerf a couple of bosses tho ;))
The major thing I did here is the first line in the general balance section. It may not seem like much but trust me that makes the whole experience sooo much smoother.
Again, super open to any feedback, let me know what you guys think of these changes, and what else would you like! :)

Note: some of the changes are not still properly translated to any languages besides english and spanish but I decided to prioritize gameplay changes first, so you'll see them in english for now, hope you don't mind!
Starter dice (Bottlecap, D3, D4 and D6) can no longer appear in any rewards or shops during a run
Dice in shops/rewards now slightly up in rarity as you progress through the run
Tweaked the code that spawns extra dice, should be behaving more consistently with dice like dumbbell
Extra dice spawned from other dice now inherit their extra value (i.e. Die of Dice)
Dice Rush now resets effects from the previous boss when going into the next one (like fires from Pyro, deactivations from Capricious, and etc)
Some bosses like The Patient, The Gluton and The Cautious can no longer appear in Dice Rush
Pocket Pencil buffed from 4X to 6X
Foam Dice now gives +5 extra value to nearby dice, as well as exhausting them
Ancient Die now guarantees a legendary die
Made Fibonacci's Die limit higher (previously it was 610, now it's 1597)
D10 buffed from +1 to +2 extra value per die on the table
Red Giant buffed from +1 to +3 face value per trigger
Ivory Die buffed from +0.1 to +0.2 stamp multiplier
Ink Die buffed from +0.2 to +0.5 stamp multiplier
Wooden Die buffed from +2 to +4 extra value
Magic Sponge now removes curses from dice, but destroys itself when it does so
Fishbone Charm buffed from +2 to +4 extra value
Square Ring now always gives a random card at the start of a new round
The Frost boss no longer deactivates one of your dice
The Envious got reworked. Its previous effect is now its plus version, the normal one now discards dice that rolled their highest face, making it quite less punishing.

The Copycat got reworked. Its previous effect is now its plus version, the normal one now divides dice with a repeated face by the number of dice with that face, making it like an inverse version of the Equivalent Link ring.
The Cautious boss can no longer spawn on Yellow Hand runs

releases.displayName: Working on a Balance Update, I need your help! (also +10k copies sold!!!)

items.text: Hey everyone!! I hope you've been having a wonderful time rolling your dice, putting on some rings... you know the deal. I've been completely out of words because of the response these past couple of days, watching you play and enjoy the game... We even sold 10k copies and reached 1,000 concurrent players, how crazy is that?! Thank so much, from the bottom of my heart, but now, it is time to give you back some love.
After I pushed a first bugfix patch yesterday I think the game's now pretty good in that regard! However, I heard you loud and clear, something in the difficulty needs to be adjusted.

My personal take on it is that there are sooo many viable builds that will get you there, but there is, of course, a lot of noise too, which is fine for experienced players who know how and what to filter out, but not so for new ones, and I can get where some frustration is coming from.

A lot of you have been complaining about bosses, and I totally get what you mean! There can be some pretty harsh boss fights, but balancing them without making them feel like a child's game is quite challenging, so I'll be focusing on buffing a bunch of dice and rings in this first balance update, and see if that helps a bit. After that, I'll focus on bosses :)
Now, I want to work along with the community to make the game better! So, let me know your top 3 worst dice, top 3 worst rings, and top 3 worst bosses.
I'll be carefully taking care of these over the weekend and get back with the update as soon as possible. So yeah, thank you so much again, and let me know! :)

so here we are! A few weeks ago I talked about this update focusing mostly on challenges and nothing else, but I decided to include most of the QoL features I've been adding as well. See, the game releases in just a few months and with Next Fest probably exposing the demo to a more broader public, I wanted them to experience the most polished version I had of the game so far :) That being said, this update contains no new dice, rings, cards or hands! just challenges, a lot of QoL+balance stuff, and loads and loads of bugfixes!

Because I wasn't expecting to include any of these in the demo, I haven't been keeping track of every single little addition/change I made, sooo yeah, this is a very rough changelog with just the important stuff laid out, there's probably smaller things you guys will notice while playing that aren't listed here. but anyways, hope you enjoy! :)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/7673c67f7bb5fa0945c9250c35e6dfb0da8214c6.gif"]

oh, and on a quick a note, I wanted to talk about the game's difficulty. if you've been playing for some time already, you may notice that in this update I reduced the target scores a little from face 2 onwards. as a player myself, I know this may seem a bit disappointing to some, as I'm "making the game easier", but you gotta keep something in mind: this demo only covers the most basic difficulty ascension level with the most basic hands, so OF COURSE it has to be accesible and easy enough for new players, as that's the point of the demo in the first place! the game being hard as hell for new players has been one of its major criticisms, so I'm just trying to soften the learning curve. I PROMISE you guys will have some crazy difficult hands and some crazy difficult challenges to overcome in the full release, just trust in me :)
that's all! happy gambling and here's the full changelog!
added Challenges, unlocked by completing a normal run, currently 2: " I can't believe it's not a D6" and "Peanuts!"
added more background types, unlocked by completing challenges
added full stats menu to the collection
added custom mouse cursor, changes color depending on which hand you're playing as

skipping ring rewards now gives you a lot more pips, to make it a viable choice

autoselect now always select dice with laconism

"double ring" card now makes every ring retrigger before moving onto the next one, instead of doing them all again in order. it shouldn't affect anything really, besides make it more comfortable to select dice with active rings
added a button to roll again when rolling dice on the map
reduced card and booster pack price on face 2 onwards
reduced target scores from face 2 onwards
optimized a bit the game to boost up perfomance
probably a shit ton of them I can't remember lol

oh boy this is a big one! this update basically focused on making a smoother experience both for experienced and new players. there's a lot to unpack here, so let's get rolling!

added starter packs. when starting a new run you will now be able to select a random booster pack before round 1 (although some like rare dice and rings are banned), to kickstart your run and make the beginning a little bit easier. this is something I thought a LOT about, and decided to stick with it because the game being too hard is one of its major criticisms right now. I know some of you already know the game back to back and this is may seem pointless or unnecessary to you, so keep in mind two things: 1. I added a skip button for those of you that want to make the game harder on yourself, 2. the full game will include "ascension" levels that are MUCH harder than the base game, so the base difficulty being just a bit easier I think makes a lot of sense. as always I'm open to feedback, and especially with this, so let me know your thoughts :)

added info menu, hover and hold shift over an item with any keywords (like face, extra value, destroy, etc) in its description to show in-depth explanations. meant to make crystal clear how some mechanics work and so new players can make better decisions

added a button in the map to skip straight to the Face Boss. this only appears whenever you meet a certain threshold of score within the face, that being 1,500 for F1, 25k for F2 and 500k for F3. this is intended for speeding up runs that are already "won" and where you don't feel like trying to get a better build, since those always end up with you wasting all of your rolls in order to advance quicker anyways

Hello everyone! First of all thank you so much for 1,500 wishlists! I've been pretty silent as of recently as there's been a lot of movement behind the curtains, so achieving that number with almost no marketing efforts is honestly amazing. Thank you all!

As I promised last time, I wanted to try and make huge monthly posts talking about development and what I've been doing, and welp there's certainly a lot to talk this time around, so let's get rolling...! (get it... rolling...)

Sooo this past month has been a beefy one. After the success of the demo, I kept working on as I said last time. But I started prototyping some new core mechanics for the game, and some ended up sticking...! (get it cause they're stamps!)
Stamps are a new major mechanic I'm introducing, and to summarize, they're my way to make Dice A Million scale infinitely.

If you've ever had a crazy strong run in the DEMO where you have the exact build you want, you probably noticed how it feels like nothing ever matters anymore and you have hit a ceiling. That's something that doesn't happen that much in other roguelikes and I came to the conclusion that it was because this game didn't have something that scaled infinitely, like stats in The Binding Of Isaac, relics in Slay the Spire, or planet cards in Balatro, if you've played any of those games, you'll know what I'm talking about.

So what do these stamps do? Good question. They raise your global multiplier for their respective face. This means, if you "level up" your 2 by taking a lot of stamps, every die with a 2 on its face will be multiplied at the end of the chain of dice & ring effects, ensuring they're useful both in early and it late game. And of course, a bunch of synergyes involving new dice and rings will be added to play around with this mechanic!

And what about dice with faces greater than 6? Great question (this guy's making a lot of questions...) I won't reveal it for now but I do have a solution for those, ensuring this mechanic is core to the game and used by every type of die!
Poor D666, don't worry honey, we haven't forgotten about you.

Of course, I've been also working on a lot of new dice & rings! Currently the demo has 57 dice and 36 rings. And the total in the current build of the game is... 91 dice and 52 rings! (so almost double the content, wow!)
As I've said before, my goal for the full release is to have 100~ rings and at least 150-200 dice.
I also want to make sure every single one of them has its place in the game and is unique in some way. So I'm carefully slowly designing and balancing them.
Here's a new favorite of mine, the Aquarium!

This one's really fun to play around with, and it can get pretty powerful with the right build. It's also one of the new set of dice that do their effect when they stay in hand, rather than when they're rolled, there will be more of these! Also be careful when handling the Aquarium, as it is quite fragile...
And speaking of fish... oh look, here's a new ring!

This one's for the keepers, for you people that keep that precious glass die in your hand until the end of the round to give an all out! For every turn that dice stay in your hand with this ring, they'll become more powerful! (I promise this is the last fish themed one)
I've been also working on new QoL features, new hands and other major stuff, but I'll save that for next time!
Oh and apart from all of this, I've been finishing up work on and ready to get to work on the next . I'm sure you'll enjoy it :)

Lastly, I wanted to make a quick note about performance, since I noticed the game does slow down a fair bit on lower end computers. From what I could test, the cause seems to be the CRT filter. Which is reassuring in a way, but probably has no quick solution I can push to the demo right now. I'm looking for a way to optimize the shader and make it run more smoothly, but in the meantime, if you're experiencing this issue, you can just turn off the filter in the settings menu and it should run a lot better, again, let me know!
Apart from me working on the game, there's been a lot of movement behind the curtains, some stuff that I can't talk about yet, and some that I don't WANT to talk about yet. Trust me you'll see...

Soo, there's been some people interested in modding the DEMO as of lately! I just wanted to make clear that I fully support this and it's been amazing seeing what people might do with my duck-taped code (please modders don't judge me).
While I may not have the knowledge or the tools at the moment, feel free to shoot me a DM or a message on the discord server in case I can help with something!

items.text: Speaking of the discord server, (which you should totally join btw as we're about to hit 100 members) I asked people there if they had any questions regarding the game or me in general, so let's get to them!
Q: Will cards receive a rework with rarities?

A: Cards function a bit different than other items like dice & rings, they're meant to be something you can rely on to fight against the natural RNG that dice have. For that reason, I didn't want to make a ton of them, just so it's easier to find the one you need. That being said, I do have plans of adding at least a couple of new ones to the standard set, and THEN make a separate card set, that will have cards that are more powerful or more weird in general. The goal is to make these separate pools, so you can still rely on getting your good old standard cards, but also get some cool new ones in some other way.
Q: If you could remove/overhaul a system in the game, which one?
A: That's something I can do, cause I'm the developer, duh.

The answer is very clear in my mind, and I wanted to talk about it in this post since it's something I've been working on recently, buuuut it sitll needs a bit more time in the oven sadly, so I'll save it for next time. It involves reworking a pretty major mechanic, so I'm making sure it works properly and feels nice to play! (so far testers have liked it!)
Q: What's your favorite flavor of icecream?
A: Coffee
Q: Why is everyone saying silly?
phew, that's all for today. see you next time! :D

Heello, back with another patch! This time I focused on balancing and loads of bugfixing. This one's also the first I've done with an in-game pop-up. I've been doing a bunch of these patches, but Steam apparently doesn't show them in the demo feed for some reason, so I figured I'd include a notification in game so everyone can keep track of the changes!

And now for the sad news: today I bring a pretty big nerf. Say goodbye to the broken Ascendant Die. A lot of people noticed how insanely strong the Ascendant die + perennial combo was, making them reach even "infinite score" so so easy, so I finally decided to remove this. This combo has been known from the first time I added the die ofc, and I knew it was VERY STRONG. The reason I kept it in was because, at the time, I felt like the Ascendant die would be pretty weak by itself otherwise, but I don't think that's the case anymore though. I've seen people do crazy stuff with the Ascendant die even without the enchantment, but of course, taking a lot more effort, and that's exactly what I want. Some people on the Discord even started challenging themselves to reach insane scores WITHOUT the ascendant die, that's how busted it is lol
Sooo yeah hope you enjoy the rest of changes and bugfixes though!
Happy gambling!

Sudoku now needs a die that ISN'T another Sudoku matching its face in order to trigger. In exchange, it now gives a 5x multiplier PER die matching its face. Meaning if you match faces with two other dice, Sudoku will now trigger twice, or thrice if you have three, and so on.
